sampling_unit: task; all models and their three trials are kept together
resource_estimand: mean per-attempt usage after averaging trials within model/task; effects are left-minus-right means and ratios of arithmetic means

bootstrap.intervals: pointwise estimation intervals, not simultaneous intervals

resource_test.method: two-sided Monte Carlo task-level sign-flip test
resource_test.null: within each task, the two complete model outcome blocks are exchangeable; the statistic is the absolute mean paired difference
resource_test.multiplicity: Holm correction across all nine model-pair by resource-metric tests

success_test.method: exact task-level sign-flip test by integer-sum dynamic programming
success_test.estimand: difference in mean task success fractions, in percentage points
success_test.null: within each task, the paired three-trial success counts are exchangeable between models
success_test.multiplicity: Holm correction across three model pairs

stability_test.definition: unstable task: exactly one or two successes out of three trials
stability_test.method: two-sided exact McNemar test on paired task-level instability indicators
stability_test.null: the discordant indicator orientations are equally probable under equal marginal instability rates
stability_test.multiplicity: Holm correction across three model pairs
stability_test.interpretation: agreement includes consistently failed tasks; it is not equivalent to successful reliability

cost.analysis: exploratory paired task-bootstrap differences and ratios only; no hypothesis test
cost.interpretation: archived framework estimates, not paid invoices

global_multiplicity_sensitivity: An additional Holm adjustment across all 15 resource, success and stability tests is reported alongside outcome-family adjustments.
scope: fixed archived routes and settings; observational model comparisons, not causal effects of matched decoding parameters
outcome_splits: success/failure resource summaries are descriptive; no within-outcome hypothesis tests
taxonomy_scope: task/attempt-level labels are available in failure_trial_catalog.csv; category-level inferential tests are not implemented; any future tests must retain task dependence
